semiconductor_relevance: High — Tokusan Logistics specializes in the logistics of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, providing comprehensive services critical to the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Tokusan Logistics offers extensive logistics services for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including dismantling, packaging, handling, storage, transportation, and installation. With over 20 years of experience, they operate temperature-controlled warehouses and specialized transportation equipment to ensure the safe and efficient handling of sensitive semiconductor equipment.
capabilities: Dismantling and packaging of semiconductor manufacturing equipment
Specialized transportation with air suspension trucks
technical_expertise: Risk assessment and safety planning in equipment handling

regional_presence.Japan: Tokusan Logistics has a nationwide presence in Japan, with sales offices and warehouses located in Shizuoka, Kanagawa, and Okayama Prefectures.
